task.description: The plan task this run worked on.

commit_message.description: The commit message for this run's changes, in the repository's style. Empty when nothing changed.

done.description: True when every plan task is done and no review thread is open: the pull request is marked ready for review after this run's commit.

rerun.description: True only when the failed checks you were handed are not this branch's (a flaky test, an outage) and you committed nothing: the job re-runs the failed jobs once.

no_changelog.description: Only with done: true. One sentence on why the whole pull request is internal work that this repository's changelog rule (CONTRIBUTING.md/AGENTS.md) gives no line: tests, CI, tooling, or dependency bumps no user notices. The `no changelog` label goes on before the final commit's checks run. Empty for anything a user of the package, image or server could notice: write the changelog line instead.
